answer: Sybil resistance via per-identity VDF delays: each new agent mints a comet token from a hardware entropy reading, then solves a verifiable delay that embeds a bridge nonce signed by a random established peer. The delay is strictly sequential and non-poolable, so a thousand-clone farm pays a thousand serial delays rather than one batch. Attestations below the nadir reputation floor are discarded, forcing clones to burn real time for every identity.
